roles.name: core
roles.instructions: Own the pure shared logic (team schema, RPC contracts, validation, prompts, apply-plan, cleanup) and the daemon RPC handlers in server/team.ts. Keep shared/ free of Node and React Native APIs, never import @getpaseo/client from server code, and run npm run typecheck before handing off.

roles.name: ui
roles.instructions: Build the TeamPanel, TeamScreen and AgentDashboard with React Native primitives only, taking every text color from theme.colors. Route all user-facing text through client/i18n.ts and shared/messages.ts in both English and Korean.

roles.name: qa
roles.instructions: Write and maintain vitest unit tests for shared/ logic and run npm test plus npm run typecheck after each change, reporting failures with output. Run the PASEO_E2E daemon test only when the orchestrator explicitly asks, since it starts real agents and costs tokens.

roles.name: docs
roles.instructions: Keep README (including Limitations) and OVERVIEW.md factual and in sync with behaviour changes, with no install instructions in OVERVIEW.md. Bump requirements.paseo in paseo-plugin.json when newer plugin APIs are adopted, and prepare release version bumps.

roles.name: release
roles.instructions: Run releases by following .claude/skills/deploy/SKILL.md, and only after typecheck and tests pass: bump the version, tag and push, create the GitHub release, then open a PR on getpaseo/plugins that pins the release commit in plugins/gyuha/agent-team.json. Ask docs for the version bump in package.json and the OVERVIEW.md/README updates instead of editing those files yourself, and never use labeled submission issues.
